title: Closed build turns cannot fall back to owner mutations or questions; native writes wait for readiness
steps: Bind a native build turn, close its server action and attempt native, file, shell, wrapped writes and questions through the shipped pre-execute listeners.
Return late success/refusal responses, start a fresh owner or Retry turn, and attempt native local writes before provision and plan readiness.
expect: The closed turn refuses all mutations and questions before owner confirmation; known reads survive without accepting an approval.
No late response changes the current turn; the new Retry must bind afresh, and ordinary owner turns retain their original behavior.
Native local writes are denied until provision and the frozen plan are ready; reads and unassigned owner writes remain available.
evidence: Local EmDash turns 2 and 3 on 27 October 2026 reproduced a closed action falling through to CONFIRM_FIRST and a local content.replace writing before provision while tracy_emdash correctly returned AGENT_DEMO_NOT_READY.
fence: A bounded turn-specific closedBuild latch is separate from build confirmation exemptions; readiness covers native local writes before their executors.

tests: a closed build refuses mutations and questions before owner confirmation, while reads and fresh turns survive
native local writes wait for provision and the frozen plan, before they can reach owner confirmation
